system.description:
Covers nearly any small- or medium-caliber handgun commonly encountered, from zip guns and holdout pieces to 9mms and standard police-issue sidearms.

Negative Traits: Loud

Concealability: Pocket

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any, if registered; Police 4, Street 3, or Underworld 2 otherwise.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
